name: Toruro
description: Toruro is a Spanish trick-taking gambling game for 5+ players using a 40-card Spanish deck. There are three pots (Cabeza, Barriga, Cola), one for each trick. Players decide whether to 'go' (ir) or pass, and those who go must win at least one trick or pay a penalty (Lulo). The card ranking features the unusual A-3-K order common in L'Hombre games.

history.origins: Toruro is a Colombian three-card gambling game, said to be popular in the state of Santander. Documented rules draw on information from Harry Viens and on the Toruro rules by Andres F Pabon published at thespiel.net. It belongs to the Rams group of trick-taking games.
timeline: 20th century: Documented as Colombian gambling game; rules by Andres F Pabon at thespiel.net.

setup.dealing: Deal 3 cards. Turn 1 card for trump.

rules.objective: Win tricks to claim the three pots (Cabeza, Barriga, Cola); players who go must win at least one trick or pay a lulo penalty.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal 3 cards + 1 trump indicator. 2. Declare: Ir (go) or pass. Must win 1+ trick if going. 3. Exchange cards (0-3). If exchanging 3, get 4 and keep best 3. 4. Play 3 tricks. Follow suit. Must trump if void. 5. First trick: Must lead Ace of trumps if held. 6. Second trick: Must lead highest trump.

strategy.basic: Only go with strong trumps. Ace of trumps guarantees one trick.
strategy.intermediate: Exchange to improve trump holding. Don't go unless you can guarantee one trick.
strategy.advanced: Calculate how many players went. More players going = harder to win a trick.

variations.name: First deal everyone must play
variations.description: In the first deal everyone must play; ensures the game does not end immediately and some lulos are in play.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes declaration rule; no engine constant overrides documented.

variations.name: Ace trump forces play
variations.description: When an ace is turned up for trump, everyone must play.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only forces all to play when ace is trump; no engine overrides documented.

scoring.description: Each trick wins its corresponding pot. Lulo penalty if going but winning zero tricks.
scoring.winCondition: Win tricks to claim pots (Cabeza, Barriga, Cola).
